dheṭ_aorist.sic_luk: 2.4.78 permits the zero-sic route; adhāt, adhātām, adhuḥ.
dheṭ_aorist.sic_kept: With sic present: adhāsīt, adhāsiṣṭām, adhāsiṣuḥ.
dheṭ_aorist.lexical_evidence: Kṣīrasvāmin and Maitreya give all three third singulars for the suckling root. The class-three placing root in PG255 has only the selected regular zero-sic active route.

deṅ_perfect.substitution: 7.4.9 supplies digi and the source explicitly replaces the ordinary reduplication. Kṣīrasvāmin gives avadigye as an independent prefixed control.
deṅ_perfect.2pl: The selected table records digyiḍhve and digyidhve. The optional retroflex/dental dh follows the iṭ condition of 8.3.79.
deṅ_perfect.aorist: adita and its family have a different formation from digye. They coincide with the class-three giving root’s middle aorist.

source_status: All full schedules are constructions supported by their archived unprefixed components and the cited traditional exemplars. Only the identified words are claimed as traditional quotations.
